findings.title: Attached beneficiary

findings.title: Plural chain after solitude

findings.reader_payoff: The accusation expands from one exposed person to a group pattern of seeking strength.
findings.containment: The number shift links the verses but does not claim that the singular figure alone represents every actor.

epistemic.reason: Focus morphology is direct; the boundary effect rests on the supplied contextual support summary.

findings.mechanism: The genitive Allah is immediately followed by accusative plural alihatan, and their related root field meets the explicit other-than relation in dun.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader hears a single reference point followed by an open plurality of substitute objects, with shared field pressure held as contrast rather than equivalence.
findings.containment: The proper name remains a proper name; the common plural is not treated as another form of the name.

epistemic.reason: The adjacent forms, number, definiteness, and governed roles are directly supplied.

branch_activations.boundary: Only the unique-name facet is active here; the branch's address, oath, or shortened-call uses are not implied.

findings.title: Worship field and hoped might
findings.claim: The clause moves from Allah and plural worship-objects to a hoped ʿizz, bringing the worship field and the desired might into a local cross-root tension.
findings.mechanism: The adopted noun names worship-targets while the closing predicate names the benefit expected from them; Allah remains the source reference that the min-dun phrase moves away from.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees the substitutes as chosen for the very support sought outside the divine reference named first.
findings.containment: This is a relation among focus roots and roles, not lexical equivalence between Allah, the plural gods, and ʿizz or a claim that the substitutes supplied it.

epistemic.reason: The local focus contact is direct; the co-occurrence and root-field interpretation are reported by the supplied support summary.

findings.containment: Shared root pressure marks a local echo only; the two forms remain grammatically and semantically distinct.

findings.title: Purpose compressed into a clitic
findings.claim: The small prefixed li binds purpose directly to the following imperfect clause, turning the rest of the verse into an explanatory aim for adoption.
findings.mechanism: The purpose prefix attaches to yakūnū, so the intended result is subordinated to the earlier taking rather than introduced as a separate sentence.
findings.reader_payoff: A short particle makes the adopters' motive part of the same grammatical movement as their act.
findings.containment: The construction marks intention and scope; it does not prove that the expected strength became real.

epistemic.reason: The prefix attachment and following imperfect clause are explicit in the focus analysis.

findings.title: Purpose reveals motive

findings.mechanism: Li introduces a purpose clause that extends through the final predicate, connecting adoption to the intended benefit.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader distinguishes what the adopters wanted from what the verse says happened.
findings.containment: The purpose is explicit; the result remains projected and is not asserted as accomplished.

epistemic.reason: Purpose scope and final predicate are directly stated in the focus syntax.

findings.reader_payoff: The reader watches a hoped false-god state enter a frame where other forms of becoming and the next-ayah outcome press against it.
findings.containment: These are separate contextual echoes, not a single established system or a verdict about which one controls the local clause.

epistemic.reason: The focus form is direct; the wider echoes and reversal are summarized rather than supplied as full context text.

findings.title: Beneficiary inside the purpose

epistemic.reason: The purpose marker and dative phrase are both explicit and their scope relation is supplied.

findings.title: Acquired worship-recipients as reinforcement

epistemic.reason: The exact Arabic anchor and all word/root coordinates agree with the focus surface, but the reader identity is legacy_unbound and the role chain remains attributed.

epistemic.reason: The focus word indices and roots match the supplied surface, but the proxy and surety roles remain a legacy_unbound contextual attribution.
